assessment: Transit-like signal vetting only; no claim of planet confirmation or novelty.

controls.note: Correlated conditional phase controls; rank is not a survey false-alarm probability.

source_holdout_caveat: Previously processed targets have retrospective holdout after parser correction; inspect results_v1 to identify them.
timing_caveat: Original holdout used an official timing-warning QLP S99--104 product. Raw measurements preserved, but weak holdout/depth inconsistency is not a robust astrophysical veto; see database_expansion/timing_safe_repeat.
